attempts.summary: Configured sudo on node1 (Alpine Linux, sudo 1.9.17p2) to log every sudo invocation — user, host, timestamp, PWD, and command — to a dedicated file /var/log/sudo-commands.log, while disabling sudo's syslog output so these entries no longer land in /var/log/messages (the general system log via busybox syslogd). Verified the behavior both before and after a full node restart, including a changed boot_id proving an actual reboot occurred and confirming the config, log file, and syslog-exclusion persisted.
